build_MOT_model_subclass: build a subclass of BaseMOTModel implementing loss and predict methods for multiple object tracking
freeze_module_parameters: freeze a named module in the MOT model by setting requires_grad to False
forward_MOT_model: run the MOT model forward pass in loss, predict, or tensor mode
check_MOT_components: check if the MOT model has detector, reid, motion, track_head, or tracker components
calculate_MOT_loss: calculate tracking losses from a batch of inputs and annotated data samples
